title: Chapter 834
text:
"Why did Black Star block my psychic perception of the Evolution Cube?"

Beep beep!

Sisko's face turned green. Just as he was in shock, his communicator rang. Taking it out, his pupils constricted, and he gritted his teeth.

It was a call from Black Star!

"Hello, is this Sisko?" Han Xiao popped his head out from the screen.

"Black Star! What did you do? "Sisko yelled.

Seeing this, Han Xiao pretended to be surprised. "Yo, I haven't seen you in a while. How did your skin turn green?"

Seeing Sisko's angry expression, Han Xiao laughed and hung up the call without waiting for the other party to reply. He no longer teased Sisko.

In order to verify the effect, Han Xiao took the initiative to call Sisko. Hearing the other party's tone, he knew that the blocking of psychic perception had succeeded. This meant that he had nothing to talk about with Sisko anymore.

Originally, Sisko's perception of the Evolution Cube had always been a hidden danger. Now that Sisko's advantage had been removed and Sisko could not track him, Han Xiao felt much more at ease.

The Arcane Church did not have an intelligence network in the Flickering World. If they wanted to deal with him, they would most likely have to rely on Sisko's perception of the Evolution Cube. Now, the Arcane Church had one less thing to rely on.

Part of the Arcane Church's obsession with the Evolution Cube came from Sisko's psychic perception. They felt that they had a high chance of getting it back. Once they lost this trump card, they would have to think twice before making a move on the Evolution Cube in the future.

Although he had decided to stay in the dynasty's outpost Planet Lighthouse to avoid the limelight, he could not hide forever. Furthermore, the Arcane Church would not be so lucky as to think that the dynasty would not be able to guess their intentions. If there was really no chance of a sneak attack, it was not impossible for them to directly attack the dynasty's outpost.

Because of the exploration of the new Star Field, the dynasty was currently the weaker party among the three Universal Civilizations. The Arcane Church might dare to have a direct confrontation with the dynasty. Although with the Arcane Church's style, the possibility of them adopting such a radical plan was not high, Han Xiao did not exclude the possibility of it happening.

After all, he had changed the storyline. Compared to the same period in his previous life, the relationship between the organizations had had a subtle change. he did not know how far the Arcane Church would go in order to snatch the Evolution Cube.

If he could make the Arcane Church know the situation, he would not be in such a passive situation in the future.

As for whether Sisko would still follow the Arcane Church to deal with him after losing his sensing ability, there was no need to worry. Even if it was to check why his psychic location was blocked, Sisko would still come over. The Evolution Cube once belonged to Sisko, so the Arcane Church would not leave him, the previous owner, to the side. Therefore, he could still monitor Sisko's whereabouts and indirectly obtain some information about the Arcane Church's actions.

"You …" Sisko was just about to continue questioning when he realized that the communication had been cut off. He was so angry that his heart was twitching.

After pausing for a while, Sisko turned around and contacted the upper echelons of the Arcane Church.

"The situation has changed. I can't locate Black Star's location."

"What?" The upper echelons of the Arcane Church were shocked and troubled. "The operation plan was already set, and such an accident happened …

Since we can't accurately grasp Black Star's whereabouts, we have to change the operation plan. "

The Arcane Church had originally planned to secretly gather an overwhelming number of Beyond Grade As, sneak into the Flickering World, and ambush Black Star when he was out exploring, killing him in one fell swoop. The premise of this plan was Sisko's location on Han Xiao.

Sisko's location had never been a problem, but at this time, Black Star had actually thought of a way to suddenly cut off Sisko's connection to the Evolution Cube, which disrupted the Arcane Church's plan.

Originally, they had planned to let a group of Beyond Grade As attack Black Star when he was alone and let Black Star fight all of them alone. This way, they could end the battle quickly and crush Black Star. After that, they could immediately return to the Shattered Star Ring through the secret stargate.

Now that they could not directly determine Black Star's location, they might have to give up on the plan of killing him and capture Black Star alive to interrogate him about the whereabouts of the Evolution Cube. If that happened, their Beyond Grade As might be delayed in the Flickering World for a long time.

In this new Star Field, the Arcane Church had almost no foundation. Every second these Beyond Grade As stayed would increase the risk. If their secret stargate was discovered and destroyed by the dynasty during the operation, these Beyond Grade As would not be able to escape the Flickering World and would become turtles in a jar.

"I need to report this to the Pope and the Bishops and let them make a decision." This upper echelon was hesitant.

Because of this change, the risk of this operation had greatly increased and exceeded the scope of his plan.

However, he was also secretly glad that this change had happened before the operation. At this time, the stowaways were still heading toward the Garu Star Cluster and had yet to build the stargate exit. The Beyond Grade As of the Arcane Church were still waiting at home, so there was still a chance to change the plan.

"Okay." Sisko was helpless. Although he was anxious, he knew that he could not order the Arcane Church around.

Through the stargate, Han Xiao only beat up Hardaway for a few days before the fleet returned to the dynasty's outpost in the Dawn Star Cluster, Planet Lighthouse.

Tarrokov had already informed Han Xiao and knew that Han Xiao would be hiding on Planet Lighthouse during this period of time. Thus, he personally led his men to welcome him at the dock.

The fleet landed, and Han Xiao walked out of the spaceship with his officers and greeted Tarrokov.

"Chief commander."

"Your Excellency Black Star."

After shaking hands and greeting each other, the two of them boarded a vehicle and headed toward the base on Planet Lighthouse.

"I wonder who will be participating in the second batch of dynasty allies?" Han Xiao asked casually.

Tarrokov had a 'I knew you would ask this' expression on his face. He pressed his wristband and projected the information of eleven organizations.

Han Xiao glanced around and nodded. He recognized all of these organizations. They were all famous organizations from different Star Fields. There were also Beyond Grade A allied organizations and Star Cluster civilizations like Klent that had submitted to the dynasty. They were all part of the dynasty.

"Constellation Corridor's Arcane Research Institute, Primeval Star River's Flame Demon Race, Blackhole Edge's Dragonblood Nation, Sea of Star Spirits' Giant Ship Ring City … A total of four Beyond Grade A organizations. Oh, three of them are familiar."

During the trip to the dynasty's mother planet a few months ago, Han Xiao had met seven Beyond Grade A dynasty allies, and three of them were participating in this exploration team.

The leader of the Arcane Research Institute was a member of the Ancient Ones, Ravenlaude.

The leader of the Flame Demon Race was someone he was familiar with, Beyoni. They had gone to fight EsGod together before. The leader of Giant Ship Ring City was also a Beyond Grade A member whom he had met before. He was also a Mechanic.

The only one he had not met before was the leader of the Dragonblood Nation, Milizaus. This person was one of the three strongest National Pillars and was on the same level as' Dark Emperor 'Clottey. He was the strongest person in this exploration team.

Among the four of them, Han Xiao paid more attention to Ravenlaude because this guy had explored the same area as him, the Garu Star Cluster. Ravenlaude was also the first owner of the Spacetime Amber in Han Xiao's previous life.

Of course, this time, Han Xiao had gotten it first, and Ravenlaude had missed the opportunity to obtain the Spacetime Amber.

Han Xiao thought for a while and asked, "The dynasty said that they will send a direct Beyond Grade A to protect me and prevent the Arcane Church from attacking. Who is that?"

Tarrokov waved his hands and said, "The plan has changed. Milizaus and Beyoni took the initiative to request to protect you. This is a better choice."

Han Xiao was stunned for a moment. He then understood something and smiled.

"They must have given me a condition."

"That's right." Tarrokov also smiled. "They want to exchange for a chance to use the Evolution Cube."

Han Xiao had expressed his attitude long ago. He would not use the Evolution Cube for the dynasty's allies for free. If they wanted to borrow it, they would have to give something in exchange. Milizaus and Beyoni both intended to use this opportunity to make a deal with Han Xiao.

"What do you think? Do you agree to their conditions?"

Han Xiao thought for a while and nodded. "Sure."

This was one more helper than the original plan, and it was an even stronger person. He naturally did not have any objections and could even use this opportunity to build some connections.

He remembered that the faction specialties of the Dragonblood Country were all kinds of Dragonblood Potions that could permanently increase one's attribute points. Han Xiao did not have a big target and only wanted a few hundred tons of them.

The second batch of exploration teams took different routes. Those who were fast would arrive in ten days, and those who were slow would take up to a month. However, they had already gathered their troops long ago and would not waste too much time.

Along the way to the base, the accommodations had already been arranged. Han Xiao led a group of officers into the accommodations.

During this period of time, he would stay there and temporarily stop going out. He would only remotely command the Black Star Corps to explore on their own. Normal exploration did not require him to do it personally, so he could rest and watch the players work.

In the desolate universe belt of the Central Galaxy …

The huge Fallen Ark fleet was slowly moving in the universe like an ocean of battleships.

"The Arcane Church said that they want to delay the operation?"

EsGod was awakened. Upon hearing Haakisen's words, he could not help but narrow his eyes.

"Reason?"

"The Arcane Church said that there's a problem with the construction of the stargate. The Red Empire also sent out the second batch of exploration teams in time, so the risk of the operation has increased. They need to adjust the plan, so they want us to be patient and continue to wait," Haakisen reported.

Hearing this, EsGod nodded slowly.

"Then we'll do as they say."

"There's one more thing." Haakisen sneered. "The Arcane Church said that there might be a possibility of a strong attack when the time comes. They hope that we can send out more fleets when the time comes."

"Because of the increased risk, they want us to send out more people to reduce losses? Their style is becoming more and more similar to the Radiant Federation." EsGod's tone was calm and indifferent. "Just agree to their request."

As long as he could obtain the Evolution Cube, he did not care about the casualties of his subordinates.

Because he had been tricked by Black Star with a fake Evolution Cube last time, EsGod's intention of cooperating with the Arcane Church was to use the Arcane Church as the middleman and borrow Sisko's psychic positioning to avoid repeating the same mistake.

This was also an important link between the two sides.

However, Sisko's psychic positioning had already lost its effect. If EsGod knew about this, he would most likely reconsider the cooperation …

However, although the Arcane Church had not finalized a new plan, they did not want EsGod to withdraw from this operation. Therefore, they deliberately hid the fact that Sisko's positioning had lost its effect from him and found another reasonable reason to delay the operation. They did not mention Sisko's problem.

Because of the deep hatred between them on Planet Avitan, the Arcane Church naturally would not tell Sisko that EsGod was involved in this operation.

Therefore, EsGod did not know about the changes on Sisko's side and was still in the dark, waiting for the operation to begin.

…

After staying on Planet Lighthouse for two days, Han Xiao had already finished reading all the information about the Spacetime Freezer that Philip had collected.

As expected, after reading it, a notification popped up on the interface. The first round of the mission had been completed rather easily.

With the reward in hand, his Soul Connection with the Spacetime Amber increased by one point. Han Xiao immediately felt a different feeling.

Somehow, his mind seemed to have established a connection with the Spacetime Amber. He no longer needed any auxiliary devices and could directly activate the effects of the Spacetime Amber with his mind.

At the same time, a special energy flowed into his body through the Soul Connection. His whole body felt warm, and Han Xiao could not help but sigh in comfort.

This energy lasted for a while before disappearing. Han Xiao was very sensitive to his body at this time, and he immediately felt that this energy had strengthened his body to a certain extent. He immediately opened the interface to check the new notification.

You have established a Soul Connection with [Spacetime Amber]. Current Level: 1/5

[Spacetime Amber] Grade: Gold Item Type: Universal Treasure

You have received the buff [Spacetime Amber's Feedback].

[Buff Duration: Constant]

"The effect of the first level is already so good." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Just like how the Evolution Cube had strengthened Sisko's psychic power, he would also be strengthened when he established a Soul Connection with the Spacetime Amber.

Han Xiao took out the Spacetime Amber and tried using it. He realized that the energy output had increased, and the speed of creating amber had increased by about twenty to thirty percent.

"It seems that the deeper the Soul Connection, the faster the speed of creating amber with this thing."

Han Xiao looked at the second round of the mission. The reward was also + 1 Soul Connection. The mission requirement was to find the whereabouts of the Spacetime Freezer's race and come into contact with his descendants.

"Er, this requirement …"

Han Xiao had a strange expression on his face.

It was not that he could not find the descendants of the Spacetime Freezer but that they were too easy to find.

He had already read all the information about the Spacetime Freezer and knew that this guy's race still existed, and they had always been affiliated with the civilization that the Spacetime Freezer had served.

The only problem was that every Beyond Grade A race had extraordinary talents, and the ratio of Supers was extremely high. They had always been viewed as important resources by the various civilizations to nurture warriors.

The Spacetime Freezer's race was also protected by the civilization that they belonged to, and no outsiders were allowed to come into contact with them.

This civilization had survived the exploration era's war and had grown into a behemoth today.

It was one of the three Universal Civilizations, the Radiant Federation!

I'm just a Beyond Grade A belonging to the dynasty. If I go to the Radiant Federation's territory …

"Do I have to infiltrate again? If I'm exposed, I'll probably be beaten to death in the Radiant Federation's territory … "

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. He was in the Flickering World and did not have time to leave. The second round of the mission was obviously not going to be completed anytime soon, so he decided to just put it aside.

Anyway, he had the treasure in his hands, so he was not in a hurry. He had another thing to do.

It had been seven days since he last used [Bold Explorer], and the cooldown was over.

This skill was like a different kind of divination. No matter how one looked at it, it was very mystical. However, after testing it, the effect was indeed outstanding.

Han Xiao brought up the wormhole data that EsGod wanted, and his lips curled up.

"Finally, I can see what secrets are hidden in this set of data!"

Although this set of data had been shared with the dynasty, under the research of the dynasty's Academy of Science, there was a high chance that it would be deciphered and obtained accurate clues in the future.

However, he chose to believe in mysticism today.
